entries.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: ONE isolated transparent equipment drawing for a warehouse game shop. Redraw ONLY the real product shown in the attached photograph with faithful proportions, silhouette, mechanical construction and source colors. Restrained hand-inked cartoon style: fine dark outlines, clean cel shading, very subtle printed texture on the object. Keep straight industrial geometry and realistic material thickness. No exaggerated knobs, toy proportions, fantasy components, wood or turquoise recoloring. No additions to the reference hardware. Remove ALL printed text, logos, labels and display digits, leaving blank clean surfaces; no replacement lettering. True alpha-transparent background, no scene, no ground, no cast shadow. Whole object fully visible, centered in a square, about 85 percent of canvas with clear padding. Not a sprite sheet. Reference subject: Mars Hydro TS1000 lamp seen from underneath. Preserve very thin white/silver bent-sheet rectangular reflector with sloping side lips, pale-gold LED circuit board and orderly array of small diode dots, corner fasteners and the exact flat proportions. IMPORTANT remove green MARSHYDRO lettering from reflector AND all dark logos/lettering on PCB. The reflective rims and the central board must have absolutely no words, emblems, logos or writing. No wooden beam, suspension rig, teal housing, knob or invented components.
